integrity: An analytic full-plane proof and independently executable rational example are included; computations are corroborative, not proof of infinite dynamics. No external independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only strict two-season alternation with 0<r,t<1, a>1, 0<b<1 and the positive Lozi fixed point. Outside this exact domain, other schedules, other fixed points, and random control are not addressed. First source publication date is the publisher online date 2022-06-18, preceding the arXiv posting 2022-08-18.
title: Sharp global stabilization and neutral two-cycles under alternating-coordinate Lozi control
